name: Process Entity Type
description: Anything a process can scan — a battery module, a slave BMS, a tyre, a fire extinguisher. Holds the QR pattern used to pull a serial, manufacturing date and module number out of the payload. Patterns live here rather than in code because vendors change their labels without telling anyone.

fields.label: Expected Count per Subject
fields.description: How many of these a complete subject should have — 3 modules, 1 slave BMS. Drives the traceability completeness score.

fields.label: Scanning Enabled
fields.description: Turn cell-level scanning on or off with one checkbox — no code change either way.

fields.label: Duplicate Policy
fields.description: Warn is the default because a legitimate rework re-scan must never be blocked.

fields.label: QR Parsing
fields.description: Patterns are tried in order; the first match wins. If none match, the raw payload is still stored and the scan is flagged for an admin to add a pattern. Nothing is ever rejected or lost.

fields.label: QR Pattern
fields.description: Python regex with named groups. Recognised: serial, mfg, module, batch, rev. One pattern per line. Example: ^(?P<serial>[A-Z0-9]{12})-(?P<mfg>\d{6})-M(?P<module>[123])$

fields.label: Manufacturing Date Format
fields.description: How to read the `mfg` group. DDMMYY matches the industry convention on cell and module labels.

fields.label: Sample Payload
fields.description: Paste a real scan here and use Test Pattern to check the parse before saving.
